hints.title: Bidirectional Hash Mapping Identifier
hints.text: Generate compact unique tokens for links and maintain reciprocal dictionaries for constant time decoding.

hints.title: Counter or Random Base Conversion
hints.text: Assign a monotonically increasing counter or short random alphanumeric hash to each new link and save mapping in both directions.

hints.title: Codec Map Blueprint
hints.text: Initialize count = 0, long_to_short = {}, short_to_long = {}. In encode(longUrl): if not mapped, key = str(count), save both maps, count += 1. Return prefix + key. In decode(shortUrl): return short_to_long[shortUrl.replace(prefix, "")].

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Constant time encode and decode operations backed by hash tables.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Reversible encryption without state produces excessively long strings for large URLs.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual hash tables trade linear memory for immediate O(1) two-way lookups.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handling of deduplication and discussion of collision avoidance in distributed environments.

solutions.approach: Dual Hash Map Incremental Counter Codec
